rules: Do not inspect or fit final-test subject trajectories before committing a frozen candidate and evaluation protocol; log any final-test access.
Do not drop incorrect repetitions because the engine does not measure the fault responsible for their label. Report that scope limitation and the resulting errors.
Retain original publisher labels; data acquisition and sensor agreement are not generated correctness annotations.
Kinect has 22 joints, with root positions absolute and other positions relative to parent frames. Do not interpret raw local positions as global landmarks.
The publisher visualization warns of lower-body reconstruction errors. Validate geometry independently before using reconstructed lower-body angles.
Verify recorded sampling rate from primary documentation. Playback speed in the visualization is not an acquisition timestamp.
Do not populate nonexistent MP33 joints, MediaPipe visibility or presence from the skeletal data. Use an explicitly separate provenance/measurement adapter.
Use full source recordings with verified aligned segmentation for continuous count evaluation. Do not join cut repetitions and invent missing start/end dwell or continuity.
A per-repetition correct/incorrect dataset label does not locate an individual joint fault or its onset time.
Only independent evaluation meeting the frozen readiness rubric can earn points. Dataset download alone earns zero points.
